s: Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a «Prince» and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.
And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the «high» «priest», were gathered together at Jerusalem.

Was returning, and sitting in his «chariot» read Esaias the prophet.

s: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is «Diana» of the Ephesians.

s: And certain of the chief of «Asia», which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
And there accompanied him into Asia Sopater of Berea; and of the Thessalonians, Aristarchus and Secundus; and Gaius of Derbe, and Timotheus; and of «Asia», Tychicus and Trophimus.

G789.d: (also Ἀσσός, -οῦ), ή Assos, a city on the E. coast of Asia Minor: (see: ἆσσον).† (AS)
s: And when he met with us at «Assos», we took him in, and came to Mitylene.

G790.d: to be unsettled, be homeless, lead a vagabond life

G725.d: a thing seized, hence, a prize

s: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith «virtue»; and to virtue knowledge;

To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have «ungodly» committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
